# Mercer & Co. New York — llms.txt
# Authorized Vesta Kitchen distributor for New York

## About
Mercer & Co. New York is the authorized New York distributor of Vesta Kitchen,
a Toronto based appliance brand founded in 2010. We supply 50 product series
across 8 categories to kitchen dealers, renovation contractors, and property
managers in the New York metro area.

- Website: https://mercernco.com/
- Dealer page: https://mercernco.com/dealer
- Blog (The Mercer Journal): https://mercernco.com/blog
- Email: info@mercernco.com
- Phone: +1 929-804-0369

## Product categories
- Range hoods (24 series, up to 1000 CFM, under cabinet, wall mount, island, insert)
- Gas and electric cooktops
- Freestanding ranges and rangetops
- Refrigerators (French door, counter depth, top freezer)
- Dishwashers (tall tub)
- Microwaves (over the range, countertop)
- Washers and dryers
- Massage chairs

## Dealer program highlights
- No minimum order quantity (no MOQ)
- MAP policy: advertised discounts may not exceed 15% off MSRP
- 2 year parts and labour warranty across the line; lifetime motor warranty on range hoods; 10 year compressor warranty on refrigerators
- Live inventory and drop shipping available
- Dealer application: https://mercernco.com/dealer

## Content
How-to guides for choosing, sizing, installing, and maintaining kitchen
appliances: https://mercernco.com/blog
